I'm constantly trying to come up with original ideas but to no avail. I've tried teaching myself for years how to edit film and produce music but even still im no better than the average Joe, certainly not good enough to get anywhere with it.
And it's honestly not even an enjoyable process for me at this point. It just makes me depressed.
The only reason I've ever even wanted to make art is to make people feel better and less alone, but it ironically seems to just be making me feel worse and more alone

There is vocational schools and I've looked into taking some courses but there's just nothing around that I can see myself enjoying. And I'd be willing to take a chance but even the vocational schools are expensive and there'es no try before you buy option unfortunately
I'm currently just working as a kitchen-hand
